name: Helkai
title: Priest of the family of Merajot
summary: Helkai was a priest who led the priestly line of Merajot in Jerusalem during the time when Joiakim served as high priest. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah among the heads of the priestly families who served after returning from the Babylonian exile. His role was to maintain priestly service and religious order in the rebuilt Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a priestly head
keyEvents.description: Helkai is recorded as the head of the priestly line of Merajot during Joiakim's tenure as high priest.

keyEvents.title: Part of the priestly system after the exile
keyEvents.description: Helkai served as part of the organized priestly structure that was restored after the Jews returned from Babylon to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Service under Joiakim's leadership
keyEvents.description: Helkai carried out his priestly duties under the leadership of high priest Joiakim, who was the son of Joshua and an important leader in the rebuilt temple.

keyEvents.title: Preservation of the priestly line
keyEvents.description: Helkai represented continuity in the Levitical priesthood, and his record ensured that Merajot's lineage was documented for future generations.
